answer_1.quote: State-of-the-art abstractive summarization systems can generate fluent summaries with high automatic evaluation scores in terms of ROUGE.

answer_2.quote: We also calculate ROUGE scores, and the percentage of n-grams and percentage of entities in the generated summaries that are not found in the source document (ENFS). ... To evaluate the faithfulness of generated summaries, we use automatic faithfulness evaluation tools FEQA and DAE.

answer_4.quote: We manually labeled each entity with one of the following three tags: non-hallucinated, factual hallucination, and non-factual hallucination.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators checked if entities were inferable from the source document and, if hallucinated, verified factuality using world knowledge via external resources like Wikipedia or Google Search.
